children.text: Fan edits function not only as a short form of entertainment, but for companies these clips function as trailers for their TV shows or movies.

Businesses are catching wind of what is popular, and are actively hiring editors to create short vertical videos for their products. Fandom edits existence had to be sought out in these niche online spaces.
The edits themselves functioned almost as a celebration of its respective fandom, but editing can’t escape its capitalist base.
Editing is now the new art form of advertising.
Therein lies the problem with no accessible form of art existing in a non-transactional way. Art that is for the sake of art is inaccessible or dying
